classified.root_cause: Kotlin Java-style getter/setter functions share names with backing fields. Cangjie has a flat declaration namespace (var + func cannot share name). Translator renders both var declaration and func declaration with same name.
classified.fix_direction: L1 — render.rs: in render_regular_class, pre-scan for var-func name collisions, rename backing var to _<name> and update all NameRef references
classified.estimated_impact: 997 errors reduced to ~150 (verbose errors are all cascading from these 8 printed)
